name: TC-03-manufacturer-model
description: TC-03.3: Manufacturer & Model — Navigate manufacturer and model lists, view detail pages

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Manufacturer List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Manufacturer. Manufacturers are linked to assets and equipment to track the make and model of each item.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Manufacturer List View
doc_metadata.caption: The Manufacturer list shows all registered manufacturers with names, countries, and contact information. Use filters to locate specific manufacturers.

steps.target: table tbody tr:first-child td:first-child a, table tbody tr:first-child, [data-testid='entity-row']:first-child

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Open Manufacturer Record
doc_metadata.caption: Click on a manufacturer record to view its details and associated models.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Wait for Page Load
doc_metadata.caption: Wait for all page components to finish loading and rendering.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Manufacturer Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The manufacturer detail page shows the company name, country, and associated models. Models link a manufacturer to specific product lines used in asset tracking.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Model List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Model. Models represent specific product lines from manufacturers and are linked to assets for detailed equipment tracking.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Model List View
doc_metadata.caption: The Model list shows all registered product models with names, linked manufacturers, and associated asset counts.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Open Model Record
doc_metadata.caption: Click on a model record to view its details and the linked manufacturer.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Wait for Page Load
doc_metadata.caption: Wait for all page components to finish loading and rendering.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.3 — Model Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The model detail page shows the model name, linked manufacturer, and any associated assets.
